en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a railway line with a steam train approaching along parallel tracks in a rural landscape. To the right stands a large brick institutional building with many windows and steep roofs, likely a school or public facility. Utility poles line the tracks, and a few people are standing near a fence in the foreground. Printed text appears at the bottom margin, with additional handwritten cursive text below it.
